concept_scope: Experimental native conditionals on explicitly supplied structural observation packets. Component field proofs remain independent. No packet, graph edge, host comparison, or collection of supported fields constitutes native conjunction or a complete strategic theorem.
partial_concepts: OverloadedDefender represents obligations and supplied counterfactual consequences, without proving they cannot all be met. TrappedPiece separates geometric exits, supported legal exits, unknown exits and unassessed desirability. Neither multiple defenses nor a low mobility count establishes the strategic concept.
partition_policy: Canonical role-labelled local motifs and equivalent structural move sequences form indivisible ancestry groups. Translation, reflection, color orientation, identity renaming, irrelevant context and counterfactual descendants stay in one split. Raw ray lengths and role topologies are held out. Pooled conditional-key overlap is measured and disclosed; no complete-board keys or label-based sampling.
training_dependence: One consistent representative per connected source/motif/transformation component per conditional; contradictory dependent components are withheld. Independent observations update positive and negative channels through native Truth_Revision.
legal_promotion: Promote only after all established legal cohorts, complete external FEN/history panels, 76 holdouts, two development recoveries, 27 temporal controls, 287 negative controls and provenance/removal gates pass with no new false-legal, false-illegal or self-check false positives. Otherwise retain the previous default and preserve failed experiments.
performance_scope: Separate isolated full, warm and incremental runs; exact output/proof/evidence parity precedes timing comparisons. Report structural scheduling and native execution separately.
git_policy: Local commits only. No push, deployment, upstream edits, new inference operators or strategic move selection.
